name: Banana Peel Jeeter XL Infused Pre-Roll | 2g
description: Banana Peel is an indica strain created through crossing Banana OG (Laffy Taffy cut) X Pestilence. This bud may be sought after for its heavy effects, but you'll be addicted after just one taste of its sweet banana flavor! The smell is very banana-y as well, although it does have touches of burning diesel as the nugs are broken apart and smoked. Banana Peel nugs have oversized lumpy bright neon green nugs with vibrant orange hairs and a coating of vivid amber crystal trichomes that look slightly golden in the right light.
